Transport Documents

Manifest kargo

A comprehensive list issued by the carrier detailing all cargo loaded on a vessel, aircraft, or vehicle, including marks, numbers, consignees, and destinations; required for customs and port authorities.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Manifest kargo?

In this glossary, Manifest kargo refers to: A comprehensive list issued by the carrier detailing all cargo loaded on a vessel, aircraft, or vehicle, including marks, numbers, consignees, and destinations; required for customs and port authorities.

How is Manifest kargo used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Pejabat bea cukai meminta manifest kargo untuk semua kiriman masuk guna memverifikasi detail kargo dan memastikan kepatuhan peraturan."

Why does Manifest kargo matter in logistics?

Manifest kargo matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A comprehensive list issued by the carrier detailing all cargo loaded on a vessel, aircraft, or vehicle, including marks, numbers, consignees, and destinations; required for customs and port authorities.

Operational example

Customs officials require the freight manifest for all inbound shipments to verify cargo details and ensure regulatory compliance.
